findings.title: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1 floating branch reference
findings.description: Rolling branch reference — action code can change silently. Has id-token:write for PyPI publish.
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker compromises pypa repo, pushes malicious code to release/v1 branch, next swiftsec release ships backdoored package to all users.
findings.impact: Supply chain compromise of swiftsec PyPI package.

findings.title: codecov/codecov-action@v4 unpinned third-party action
findings.description: Moving tag — previously compromised in 2021 supply chain attack. Runs with access to env vars including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
findings.exploit_scenario: Codecov action updated with credential-harvesting code, runs on every CI push.

findings.title: 5 Docker publish actions unpinned
findings.description: setup-qemu, setup-buildx, login, metadata, build-push — all tag references with GITHUB_TOKEN flowing through.

findings.title: nuclei binary curl|unzip without version pin or checksum
findings.description: releases/latest + no SHA-256 verification. MITM or compromised GH release can substitute malicious binary running as root during build.
